subject: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)
body:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Hyejin Park <hyejin_park@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 22, 2026 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)

Team,

As discussed, proposing we enable bounded autoscaling (min/max + clamp audit events) for two design partners in production over the next ~2.5 weeks. Goal is to de-risk the GA path while keeping rollback simple and explicit.

Design partners + target regions
1) HelioSearch (Dedicated pool: HS-serve-01)
   - Region: us-east-1
   - Hardware: H100 80GB (dedicated slice)
   - Primary success metric: avoid ramp latency spikes during weekday morning traffic; keep spend predictable

2) NorthPeak (Dedicated pool: NP-prod-02)
   - Region: us-west-2
   - Hardware: A100 80GB (dedicated)
   - Primary success metric: strict max cap + explainable scaling decisions

Rollout plan (proposed dates)
- Jan 27 (Tue): confirm bounds configs + customer approval; ensure allowlist + feature flag ready
- Feb 03 (Tue): enable in staging for both pools; run bounded ramp test (ENG-2849 suite)
- Feb 06 (Fri): HelioSearch production enable (business hours, with on-call coverage)
- Feb 10 (Tue): NorthPeak production enable (business hours, with on-call coverage)

Scope for design partners (what’s ON vs OFF)
- ON: hard min/max enforcement; clamp_reason logging; Console Scaling History panel; manual freeze/pin support
- OFF (for initial DP window): predictive pre-scale (forecast blending) unless we explicitly re-enable later per customer

Rollback commitments
- Within 30 minutes: disable bounded-autoscaling flag for the pool (reverts to current autoscaler behavior)
- Within 60 minutes: optionally pin replicas to last-known-good value (or customer requested) + freeze scaling if oscillation
- Same-day: revert customer bounds config (control plane) if they want the fields cleared

Owner asks
- Connor: confirm allowlist workflow + “kill switch” operational steps and ownership during rollout window
- Sean: confirm paging thresholds + coverage for each production enable date (do we need temporary lower thresholds?)
- Markus/Hyejin/Rachel/Dev: confirm customer comms + who is on the customer bridge for HelioSearch and NorthPeak

Attaching draft rollout plan + config template.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Fleet Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: DesignPartner_RolloutPlan_BoundedAutoscaling_2026-01-22.pdf
Attachment: DesignPartner_ConfigTemplate_Bounds.csv

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Hyejin Park <hyejin_park@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 22, 2026 at 10:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)

Works for me.

Allowlist + kill switch details:
- Feature flag: dedicated.autoscaling.bounds.enabled
- Allowlist keyed by dedicated_pool_id (not org) so we don’t accidentally enable other pools
- Rollback: flip flag off in control plane (propagates < 5 minutes); autoscaler will stop clamping immediately

One note: if we’re keeping predictive OFF for DP, we should confirm the autoscaler build we deploy does not attempt to fetch forecast inputs (or it’s no-op). I’ll double-check the current deployment is on pr-21941 scaffolding which is safe.

If you want, I can also add a second “emergency freeze” flag dedicated.autoscaling.freeze that forces applied_replicas = current and suppresses scale actions (but still emits metrics). This is already used in incident drills.

- Connor

---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Hyejin Park <hyejin_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 22, 2026 at 11:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)

SRE can cover both enables if we keep them during business hours PT.

For paging, I want to keep it simple and aligned with what we’ll run at GA:
- Bound violations: page immediately (should be 0; severity high)
- Scale lag: ticket + slack alert unless customer impact; page only if p95 latency breaches SLO for >10 mins
- Oscillation: slack alert first; if >3 scale direction changes within 30 mins AND p95 latency regresses, page

Request: for each partner, can we document the expected behavior when max is hit?
- We should expect throttling/queue growth. Customer needs a clear statement: “max is a hard cap; if demand exceeds capacity, you’ll see throttles/latency; raise max or enable burst.”

If PM is OK with it, I’d like Console to show a warning banner when max clamp happens repeatedly (I know that’s not in first DP scope, but at least in runbook/customer email).

Sean

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Hyejin Park <hyejin_park@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 22, 2026 at 12:04 PM PST
Subject: Re: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)

Agree on messaging.

For DP window, we should set expectations explicitly:
- “Hard max” is the contract / spend guardrail
- “Min” is maintained best-effort during maintenance/drains (we’ll communicate any deviations)
- If max is hit, the system will not scale above it; customer can either raise max or accept throttling

Markus/Hyejin: please include a short paragraph in the customer note about what their operators should do if they see sustained clamp_reason=max_bound (raise max / relax cooldown / enable burst-to-max).

Vanessa: can you propose initial bounds for each (min/max + cooldown) based on their current baseline usage? I want to avoid the HelioSearch ‘max too low’ scenario we saw in SUP-4874.

Lauren Bishop
Product, Dedicated

---

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hyejin Park <hyejin_park@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 22, 2026 at 2:26 PM PST
Subject: Re: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)

Looping in customer-facing plan draft below. If everyone’s OK, we’ll send separate emails to each customer tomorrow with:
- rollout date/time (local time + PT)
- region + pool identifier
- what changes (hard max + scaling history)
- rollback commitment + escalation contact

We can also set up a 30-min “enablement” call for each on the day before production enable.

Open question: do we want HelioSearch first (Feb 6) and NorthPeak second (Feb 10) as proposed? NorthPeak has been the most sensitive about spend controls, but HelioSearch is more likely to notice latency if anything is off.

My leaning: keep as proposed; HelioSearch is lower blast radius and more collaborative on tuning.

-Markus
Solutions Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hyejin Park <hyejin_park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 9:08 AM PST
Subject: Re: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)

+1 keep HelioSearch first.

Initial bounds proposal (based on last 14d baseline + peak hour; sanity checked with fleet capacity):

HelioSearch (us-east-1, HS-serve-01)
- Current steady-state: 4 GPUs; typical morning peak: 6; rare spikes to 8
- Proposed:
  - min_gpus: 4
  - max_gpus: 8
  - scale_up_cooldown: 60s
  - scale_down_cooldown: 10m
  - max_scale_up_step: +2 per minute
  - burst_to_max: enabled (but capped at max=8)

NorthPeak (us-west-2, NP-prod-02)
- Current steady-state: 8 GPUs; peak: 10–12 depending on evaluation load
- Proposed:
  - min_gpus: 8
  - max_gpus: 12
  - scale_up_cooldown: 60s
  - scale_down_cooldown: 15m (they care about stability)
  - max_scale_up_step: +2 per minute
  - burst_to_max: enabled

Notes:
- These are strict clamps at the autoscaler controller (no policy exceptions). If max is reached we will not exceed it.
- During maintenance/drains, we treat min as best-effort; we will notify if we anticipate going under min for >15 mins.

Connor: once you confirm allowlist mechanics, I’ll put in the change request for enabling staging Feb 3.

Vanessa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 4:42 PM PST
Subject: Re: Design partner rollout plan: bounded autoscaling (NorthPeak + HelioSearch)

Support readiness notes:
- Please include in customer email: “If you see throttling/queueing after setting max, open a Sev-2 with ‘Autoscaling Bounds’ in subject and we’ll route to Fleet/SRE.”
- For the rollout window (Feb 6 + Feb 10), we’ll have a dedicated escalation Slack channel internally and I’ll be primary Support point.

Also: can we confirm who is the DRI for customer-facing rollback authorization? If a customer asks “disable bounds now,” I want a clear owner.

Dev Patel
Support Lead
Redwood Inference
